attributes.action: Reintroduce the death penalty for peadophiles and child murderers.
attributes.additional_details: The recent case involving the abuse and murder of baby Preston Davey has shocked and horrified the public. We believe that those who commit the most serious crimes against children should face the strongest possible punishment. We believe current sentencing arrangements do not adequately reflect the gravity of these offences and that Parliament should debate whether capital punishment should be reinstated for such crimes.
attributes.background: We want the Government to introduce legislation allowing courts to impose the death penalty on offenders convicted of the murder of a child and the most serious sexual offences against children.

rejection.details:
We have three petitions currently open which cover all the things you appear to be requesting of the Government in your petition - you may wish to sign one, two or all of these:
